name: Queima das Fitas: Cortejo Académico
description: Witness one of Porto's most cherished traditions as thousands of university students parade through the city in a vibrant, festive procession of decorated floats, music, and celebration.
longDescription:
The Cortejo Académico is a central component of Queima das Fitas, Porto's annual student festival. This procession involves thousands of university students, organized by their respective faculties, parading through the city centre. The event marks the end of the academic year for graduating students and is a tradition deeply rooted in Portuguese university culture, signifying a transition point for those completing their degrees. Each faculty prepares elaborate, often satirical, floats for the occasion.

Attendees witness a large-scale outdoor spectacle characterized by student camaraderie and celebratory atmosphere. The procession typically lasts several hours as it winds through the historic streets of Porto, accompanied by music and cheers. Participants wear traditional academic capes and costumes, adding to the visual distinctiveness of the event. The audience comprises a mix of locals, families, former students, and tourists observing the cultural display.

The Cortejo Académico takes place in the City Centre on 2026-05-07 and is free to attend. Spectators can position themselves along the parade route. The city centre is well-served by public transport, with numerous metro stations (e.g., Trindade, Aliados, São Bento) and bus stops within walking distance of the route. As an outdoor event spanning public streets, accessibility varies along the route.
